analysis: Vitamin D has been shown to play a role in glucose metabolism and insulin sensitivity. Several studies suggest that adequate levels of Vitamin D may reduce the risk of insulin resistance, obesity, and metabolic syndrome. While other vitamins have their own health benefits, Vitamin D is most directly associated with these specific metabolic effects.
